caption: The drawing depicts an architectural column capital with detailed ornamentation. The main object, occupying the left and center portions of the composition, is a dark green or blue-green column with classical features. At the top, there is a large abacus and a decorated frieze with a row of circular, braided motifs. Below the abacus and frieze, a stylized face with pronounced features (including curled hair or horns on either side of the head) is centrally positioned, framed by two vertical bands that run down the column. Below the face are three disk-like shapes arranged vertically. The background is a plain beige color. To the right of this main illustration is a smaller, line-drawn version of the full column, showing the entire structure from the base to the capital in a simplified, less detailed manner. The small drawing reveals that the capital is situated atop a slender, rectangular shaft and rests on a simple plinth base. The image also contains a small, handwritten signature “V. Van Kotal” at the bottom left corner of the page.
title: Cast Iron Pillar
